scientific_interpretation: Arm A demonstrates that a later independent reviewer can break a correlated miss, but also that an additional reviewer can reintroduce a previously corrected error or ignore supplied context. Review depth therefore cannot be treated as monotonically improving quality, and majority/finality-by-latest-review would be unsafe. Protected adjudication and platform-owned convergence remain necessary.
